all.statement: Each QHooks launch contract adds a launch’s tokens (the supply minus any creator reserve, at most 30%) to its Uniswap v4 pool as one position owned by the launch contract itself (PoolManager position key: owner = launch contract, salt 0). Its verified source has exactly two calls that modify that position: one adds liquidity at launch, one changes it by 0 to collect fees. No function decreases or withdraws liquidity, and the contract has no owner, admin, upgrade, delegatecall or selfdestruct.
